action_items: User-reported Calendar bug 'events not appearing' is NOT reproducible — events appear correctly on /calendar (Mar 1, Mar 15, Apr 15, Jun 15 verified). Ask user for exact reproduction steps or specific event names not appearing.

If user expects events with event_date=NULL (6 of 12) to appear on calendar grid, that's a product decision — currently they only appear in List View, not Month Grid. Consider showing 'No date set' bucket or warning user when creating events.

demo.agency@kora.com does NOT have access to /food-ops/menus (redirects to /dashboard). For frontend culinary P2 testing use pamemey27@gmail.com as established in iteration_175. Backend culinary P2 endpoints all verified working with demo.agency.
critical_code_review_comments: Proposals are event-scoped: there is no GET /api/proposals listing endpoint. Frontend correctly uses /api/events for the list view at /client-engagement/proposals. Document this clearly so future agents don't expect a generic /api/proposals collection.
POST /api/events requires both client_id (mandatory) and event_date (optional). When created without event_date, the event is invisible on the calendar grid — UX could warn user.

TZ handling check: EventCalendarTab.js line 100 uses date.toISOString() — verified events with 'YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00' from backend are correctly matched by CalendarPage and EngagementCalendar; no off-by-one observed for Mar 1 and Mar 15.

success_rate.frontend: Calendar list/grid OK, Proposals list OK, Event detail/Proposal editor OK; food-ops not testable with demo.agency
